blind.description: A stylized fantasy blacksmith idol or prop consisting of an ornate anvil mounted on a bevelled rectangular plinth, with a massive runic warhammer resting upright on its top face. The anvil features sculpted filigree and flared brackets in bronze/copper tones on a dark charcoal-grey iron body. The hammer has a thick faceted stone or metal head etched with runes, bronze trim, a wrapped leather grip, and a faceted pommel. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly stylized without floating shards or mesh errors.
blind.from_above: From directly overhead, the elongated hammer handle and head dominate the view, resting diagonally across the anvil's top deck, with the anvil horn and base corners protruding on either side.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top of the hammer reaches roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 3 ft tall), with an overall footprint around 2.5 to 3 ft wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.62x off the catalog (5.6 x 2.9 ft)
gemini note: etched runes on hammer head
